policy: Permissive licenses are allowed. Anything else needs a reviewed exception naming the package, the license and why it is acceptable for this use. Copyleft (GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL) is not accepted for shipped code.

reviewedExceptions.reason: Test-only accessibility engine (M12 browser suite); used unmodified, never shipped in the web bundle or a service image. MPL-2.0 is file-level weak copyleft.
Test-only Playwright binding for axe-core (M12); used unmodified, never shipped.
Vite's CSS transformer and its per-platform native binaries (build time only); used unmodified, its output is our CSS, it is not linked into shipped code.
